reviews.text: Great experience. Staff very helpful. DR. K is +++++ highly recommend 👌 …

We have had good experiences with Dr Benjamin and Dr Krieger. We just had a great consultation with Dr Krieger regarding my dog’s current issues, which we found very helpful to our situation, and for which we are grateful.
Always have a positive experience!  They truly care about the pets and pet parents.

Jennifer was amazing ! She made it super easy for my baby to feel safe and calm . Shes usually scared of other people but she warmed up to Jennifer so easily and it was so comforting to see someone care for my dog in a way I haven’t seen others do ! Best service ever !!
Very kind and caring staff explained step by step during visit for sick kitty.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
The doctors care for your pet as if they are their own. The staff are equally great.
Everyone is very kind
Always efficient service, attentive and caring. Prices are very reasonable compared to other veterinarian clinics that I looked into
Always good amount of appointments listened to my pet concerns and gave me options. Thank you Westchester veterinary clinic.

They’re so professional and friendly! They take excellent care of my dog and really hear me out and take every concern very seriously. They make personal touches like walking my dog out in laser safety glasses after his procedure so I can see how cute he is or even just remembering his name when we walk in the door. I am so happy I found them!

Editing my review as I've been taking my dog here for years now. I moved to a different town and still make the trek 1-2x a month for my senior dog because he's in such good hands here. Last month, he had a cardiac event that was really scary - my dog had to be taken to an emergency hospital. Not only did the Doctor working that day text the VCA emergency department for updates, they called to brief them while we were on the way, sent over my dog's medical records, did not charge me for the appointment, and called to cancel a previous cardio appointment I'd made and offered me a refund or credit. Drs Benjamin, Krieger, and their new doctor (so sorry I don't remember her name, but she is the one who helped my dog during his episode) care about my dog (and me!) as if we were family. They recognize my dog when we walk in, and I've even become buddies with Brandi at the front desk - she is literally the best. I love a Brandi/Dr Benjamin day because it feels like I just get to yap with friends while my dog gets excellent care. I will continue to take my dog and any future pets here because it's truly the best vet office ever.
Staff is extremely friendly and loving to my doodle and accommodated her appointment
If you are looking for a Vet, I highly recommend Westchester Veterinary Center and Cat Clinic. Our fur babies are so important and my Miss Kitty, receives exceptional care.
Very friendly and knowledgeable staff !

Updating review to reflect our experience.

Brandy has gone above and beyond to make sure our experience was a great one. She was able to provide exceptional service with such excellent fashion that it changed our minds, which is so hard to do. She truly has a skill!

The second visit we had, the vet “Behin” (sp?) was great and the tech who helped her. She had a lot of patience and took her time to show us how to make sure we were treating the dog the exact way we needed to ensure complete resolution.

We look forward to moving towards resolution and having our dog come to complete recovery.

I took my dog in for a sore. Westchester Vet took her in the same day I called. They were thorough and kind with my pup. They explained everything that was wrong and explained all the charges, both needed and optional. They were great with my pup and called to check-in on her the next day.

We always get excellent care from Westchester Veterinary Center. When I called for an appointment, they offered me Sunday, when they have reduced rates.  We were seen within 10 minutes of our appointment, and everyone that we dealt with were kind and caring. I highly recommend them.
Courteous, professional, caring

This was my first time at Westchester Vet Clinic  ( and I live in Westchester!)  I sure wish I had come here years ago.
When i  could not get an appointment at my ling time Vet clinic for my small dog's  sudden eye infection..I saw the great reviews for Westchester Vet Clinic , called and got an appt the next day.
Dr. Robertson was terrific.. and I am going to switch now to this clinic. ( 3 min drive from my house ) great experience!

Love this vet. I started coming here in 2018 and they've only gotten better since then. Been to another couple of vets in the area and keep coming back here, even though I moved farther East, they're just such clear and helpful communicators and are so sweet with my cats and dog.

I recently visited a veterinary clinic and had a great experience. Overall, I would rate their service 5 out of 5 stars because everything was handled professionally and with care. From the moment I walked in, Brandi from the front desk was very welcoming and made me feel comfortable. They greeted me with with kindness and were ready to answer any questions.
One thing that stood out was the excellent customer service. The workers were patient, respectful, and showed that they truly cared about both the pets and their owners. They explained everything clearly and made sure everyone understood what check-up was being done. This helped build trust and made the visit feel stress-free.
The clinic itself was very clean and organized, which showed that they take their work seriously. The veterinarians were knowledgeable and handled the animals gently, showing experience and compassion. They worked efficiently while still taking time to make sure every pet was cared for properly.
Another positive part of the visit was how quickly everything moved. Even though there were other customers, the wait time was reasonable and the process was smooth. It was clear that the clinic values both quality service and customer satisfaction.
Overall, I would highly recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone looking for reliable pet care. Their amazing customer service, cleanliness, professionalism, and genuine care for animals make them deserving of a 5 out of 5 star rating.
Thank you so much!

Another wonderful experience with Dr. Krieger! Spoke with Brandi and she was able to fit me right in. She is always so nice and gives my pup Lexi extra cuddles and attention when we come in. The tech working with my Lexi was also so sweet I think her name was Desiree 10/10 recommend

I took my dog there and was incredibly disappointed with the services they provided.  They handled the entire matter so unprofessionally, failing to conduct a proper exam. Had they conducted a proper exam, my dog wouldn’t have continued to suffer for two more days.  When I called the clinic and asked why they didn’t even bother to look inside his mouth, they had no answer.  My dog wasn’t eating!  I told them he yelps if I try to look inside his mouth. “Brandy”, the office manager, was so incredibly rude on the phone with me — when I asked why certain things weren’t done.  Here is her answer: “You don’t have to come back”.  Trust me — DO NOT TAKE YOUR SICK ANIMAL THERE.

Lucy did well with surgery thanks to the Amzing Doctor. Lucy heart gave them some problems but they were able to stabilize her. The Dr. Was so kind explaining it all to me  I highly recommend Westchester Veterinary
Such a great experience with Brandi & the rest of the Westchester Vet staff! Thank you for taking care of our girl!

Quick appointment scheduling, very thoughtful staff and Dr.
All tests and procedures were explained in detail.  Great experience as usual. I will continue with practice in future. I highly recommend.
No wait time and exam was very thorough! Vet gave me options for care and discussed in detail what my options were.
Very attentive and helpful staff!

I took my little Lucy for her first exam yesterday. The staff was very nice and informative. Made recommendations for more vaccine. Lucy received the 3 important ones for now. Have her scheduled to be spayed. I was very happy with the service

Appointment at 11am. Arrived at 1055am. Sent to room quickly, however, waited 30 mins without seeing anyone. Left at 1130am sadly. Prob won't go back again. Very disappointed by the waste of time.

Vets could be good but I wasn't able to find out.

Getting there can be tricky. Just keep in mind - it's located on Sepulveda right before LAX. Be prepared to battle Ubers, Lyfts, Waymos, Limos as you get in and out of the parking lot if your appointments are in rush hours. It could be bad for your blood pressure.

Situation:
We took our 1-yr-old cat for an initial exam because we'd like to find a local Veterinarian for annual check-ups and vaccines, etc. We adopted him several months ago and he's had all vaccines and is in great health. So no issues to deal with. We chose to visit Westchester Veterinary Center after watching some videos of Dr. Benjamin and seeing that it was supposed to be a 'A Cat-Friendly Practice'.

Pros:
::Dr. Drew Krieger. He was warm, personable, professional, and earnest. He informed us of diagnostics, etc. without 'pushing' or 'upselling'. He's the only reason we'd consider continuing with Westchester Veterinary Center in future. Honestly, though, that's a slim chance. (Wish he were at a different practice.)
::Making an appointment online was easy.
::Introductory exam fee is very budget-friendly.
::Staff were pleasant enough though not particularly welcoming. Especially to a new client / patient. The Vet Tech (??) who did the intake (and then took our kitty away to wherever!) was nice but she didn't even tell us her name or that she was a Vet Tech (was she??) or where / why she was taking our kitty elsewhere.

Cons:
::This is from their website: "A Cat-Friendly Practice. We're proud to be a cat-friendly clinic! Our feline patients enjoy a dedicated reception area and separate examination room, ensuring a calm, comfortable experience away from our canine friends. This thoughtful approach helps reduce stress and anxiety during veterinary visits."
But there was no dedicated area and no mention of it when we arrived. We waited with doggie-parents in the same reception area.
::The Dr. we had waited to schedule an appointment with was not in. We received no prior notice that Dr. Benjamin was no longer available on that date / time. We should have received some warning and been given the opportunity to reschedule with her prior to trekking down there. Ultimately, Dr. Krieger left a great first impression but we still should have been advised prior to keeping the appointment.
::The place is more than a bit dingy and worn down. The reception area seating is very limited and there wasn't enough room for all patients / clients. (When we were checking out, people had to stand with their pets because seating was taken.)
::The exam room — ermm, or the room with a dirty exam table where they take you for before taking your kitty off to who-knows-where — is tiny, dingy, and sad.
::Without any explanation, the Vet Tech (??) took our cat away to... well, to be examined elsewhere in back we assumed since she didn't tell us where she was taking him.
::We kept getting automated email and text messages to complete the new patient form and email records to them even after already doing so. Like someone on their side wasn't checking or updating things.
::They have a sign in the exam room / holding cell that asks you to scan a QR Code and leave a Google Review in exchange for a goodie bag of stuff. That's a no-no. Google prohibits that, explicitly stating "You are welcome to ask your clients/customers for a review, in fact Google encourage this. But you can't offer up an incentive/prize for doing so." So take reviews with a grain of salt.

Conclusion:
We elected not to do any diagnostics because it's doubtful we'll continue with Westchester Veterinary Center as our Veterinary solution. Though, we can highly recommend Dr. Drew Krieger to those interested in checking out the practice directly.
Wonderful experience with Dr. Benjamin and all the staff! Dr. Benjamin is extremely competent, kind, funny, and wonderful with my senior Yorkie.
Thank you so much
The doctors and staff are so friendly and caring. They really care about all their animal patients and families.
Thank you so much !

everyone is terrific from the time you walk in the door
Vet tech and doctors are all great

I found these vets after diligent research because my senior cats have been letdown by my previous vet ( Center Sinai) that were recently acquired by new corporate owners. They once were pretty dang good. One of my precious cats passed away a year ago, 24 hours after a visit after he stopped pooping, eating and drinking water;  I was told he was probably just constipated and sent home. Then a few months later, during a senior wellness appointment, my other senior cat was dismissed for just being old and told she probably had IBS or feline lymphoma, and should just be made comfortable till she is ready to be euthanized. He barely even touched her at all. Unreal!! I knew something more was wrong and I begged this new, young inexperienced vet to please just look at her mouth/gums; I was told that was for a dental expert and he barely did anything. $380 later, my sweet baby kept not feeling well and worsening halitosis. I found these AMAZING docs, Dr. Benjamin and Dr. Krieger, at Westchester Veterinary and Cat Center. Just WOW!! What a difference…. A bit expensive but worth it (the same as most animal clinics in the area). They are upfront about costs and I think offer plans to help if you can’t afford it.  After performing necessary bloodwork/Xray to make sure she could handle the anesthesia she was immediately booked for dental workup and costs were made clear upfront before the appointment was scheduled. While under, they found she has been suffering with a malignant squamous cell carcinoma and at my behest, Dr. Krieger successfully cauterized the cancer, extracted 2 teeth and now she is recovering beautifully!! This is an aggressive cancer and likely to come back soon but together we will figure out the next steps. I’m so happy to find caring and supportive vets for my 17 year old fur baby. I HIGHLY recommend!!

Staff is nice. Disappointed in the manner in which service was provided for my dog. Focus seem to be on establishing a long-term treatment program. The PRIMARY reason for visit was not adequately discussed until I opened up dialog. Basically, visit was ineffective.
it was great Service

Called to schedule a new client appointment, front desk took down all of my information including my previous vet information and assured me they would contact them for previous records.  I did not receive any confirmation text, but I gave them the benefit of the doubt that maybe they took down my phone number wrong.  I showed up for said appointment and the front desk had no record of me making an appointment (or any appointment for the time slot I was told), and did not see my pet.

Westchester Veterinary Hospital is the only place I trust for care of my senior dog. Dr. Krieger is kind, professional, compassionate and thorough. Support staff is always pleasant. Treatment options are fully explained, and they do not “upsell” services like I’ve experienced at other vets.
I was a new client and brought my dog in to check on a suspected ear infection. Everyone was so nice and helpful and I’m definitely going to be coming here from now on.
We love Dr. Benjamin! She’s the absolute best :)
Fast service. Straight to the point, I like that they present you with estimates. Thank you Dr.Benjamin and Desiree

Desiree, Jen, and Brandi are truly exceptional. These ladies are kind, knowledgeable, and deeply compassionate in everything they do. You can tell they genuinely care about every animal that comes through their doors, treating them as if they were their own. They take the time to explain everything clearly and always make you feel confident that your pet is in the best hands. It’s rare to find a team so dedicated to doing what’s right for the animal, no matter what, and I’m incredibly grateful for them all. Keep up the good Lord’s work ladies! 🫶🏼

I had such a positive experience at this animal clinic! Everything was handled so smoothly, and the environment felt calm and welcoming from the start. I especially want to thank Desiree—she was so kind, attentive, and made sure my pet felt comfortable the entire visit. You can tell she genuinely cares and takes pride in what she does. The whole team was professional and thorough, and I left feeling really confident in the care my pet received. Definitely a place I trust and would recommend!

This clinic seriously exceeded my expectations. The space was clean, organized, and had a really calm vibe, which made a big difference for my pet. The team was efficient but never made us feel rushed, and everything was handled with so much care and attention to detail. I appreciated how smooth the whole process was from check-in to checkout. It’s clear they run things with both professionalism and heart. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending them to others! Thank you brandi and Jen for all the assistance!
Thank you so much from us all at Westchester
Desiree was Absolutely the sweetest gentle when I took my sick baby  Unfortunately she had cancer and had to be put down . I didn’t get a chance to let her know that. Thank you Desiree
